source_text:
## Acceptance checklist (2026-09-30)

- [ ] Wikipedia gold JSON contains at least 1,000 well-formed symbol/canon pairs across at least 500 articles, including a recorded 30-pair hand sample.
- [ ] Combined PM and Wikipedia gold contains at least 1,500 pairs across at least 800 entries and reports the per-source precision delta.
- [ ] Strategy gating plus canon-ancestry comparison achieves at least 25% loose precision on the combined gold.
- [ ] The final evaluation reports at least 30% loose precision, no high-volume strategy below 15%, and no more than a five-point recall drop.
- [ ] The full pipeline completes cleanly on 100 papers and emits loadable evaluation JSON plus a structurally valid learned-vocabulary side file.
- [ ] Joe's explicit approval is recorded after review of the precision report, 100-paper output, and scale economics, before Rob's batch is sent.

fragments.rationale: The heading frames everything below as a dated, enumerated go/no-go checklist: acceptance is declared up front as checkable conditions rather than left to post-hoc judgement.

pattern_refs.rationale: The checklist is exactly a prose form of encoded go/no-go quality bands; the pattern's next step is making these bands a runnable checker independent of the producer.

fragments.text: Wikipedia gold JSON contains at least 1,000 well-formed symbol/canon pairs across at least 500 articles
fragments.rationale: Fixes minimum corpus size and well-formedness as numeric gates the gold JSON must clear before it counts.

pattern_refs.rationale: A numeric band (>=1000 pairs, >=500 articles) is a gate-as-code condition: checkable mechanically, not a prose aspiration.

fragments.rationale: The bulk extraction must be anchored by a small recorded hand-checked sample, so gold quality is evidenced by human verification, not asserted by volume.

pattern_refs.rationale: A golden set earns its name from hand verification; the 30-pair recorded sample is the curated core that keeps bulk scraped pairs honest.

pattern_rejections.reason: That pattern defends a small-n study design as the research method; here the 30-pair sample is a verification anchor subordinate to a 1000-pair bulk requirement, not the object of study.
pattern_rejections.query: small verified sample before trusting the bulk extraction

fragments.text: Combined PM and Wikipedia gold contains at least 1,500 pairs across at least 800 entries
fragments.rationale: Sets size floors for the merged corpus so combination must grow coverage, not merely concatenate.

pattern_refs.rationale: Another numeric go/no-go band on the merged artefact, same checker-shaped acceptance logic as s2.

fragments.text: and reports the per-source precision delta
fragments.rationale: Merging is only accepted if the evaluation makes each source's precision explicit and reports their delta, so a weak source cannot hide inside the combined number.

pattern_refs.rationale: The pattern makes evidence weighting explicit per observation channel; a reported per-source precision delta is exactly per-channel precision made visible.

fragments.text: Strategy gating plus canon-ancestry comparison achieves at least 25% loose precision on the combined gold
fragments.rationale: The intermediate mechanism must clear a stated precision floor on the combined gold before the final evaluation is even meaningful.

pattern_refs.rationale: A precision floor the mechanism must clear is a quality band; encoding it as a checklist item is the prose form of a runnable checker.

pattern_rejections.reason: That pattern is about checking episode length against a detection threshold in realtime monitoring; this is a static precision floor on an extraction strategy, no temporal episodes involved.
pattern_rejections.query: threshold that a strategy must clear to count

fragments.text: The final evaluation reports at least 30% loose precision, no high-volume strategy below 15%, and no more than a five-point recall drop
fragments.rationale: The ship gate is a triple of numeric bounds — floor on headline precision, floor per high-volume strategy, cap on recall cost — so the pipeline cannot pass by trading one metric off against another.

pattern_refs.rationale: Three simultaneous numeric bands are precisely go/no-go quality bands; the checklist item exists so prose cannot be rubber-stamped.
The bounds target the claimed property itself (precision/recall on gold) rather than a proxy like run completion or pair volume, which is the distinction this pattern names.

fragments.text: The full pipeline completes cleanly on 100 papers and emits loadable evaluation JSON plus a structurally valid learned-vocabulary side file
fragments.rationale: Before any paid/large batch, a bounded 100-paper run must complete cleanly and produce artefacts that downstream tools can actually load — plumbing-green plus output-valid.

pattern_refs.rationale: A bounded 100-paper pass through the real pipeline before Rob's full batch is exactly a smoke run: cheap discovery of failure at n=100 rather than at full corpus price.

fragments.text: Joe's explicit approval is recorded after review of the precision report, 100-paper output, and scale economics, before Rob's batch is sent
fragments.rationale: The outward, irreversible act (sending the batch) is blocked on a recorded operator approval at the exact locus where it would fire, conditioned on review of named evidence.

pattern_refs.rationale: Sending Rob's batch is an outward act; requiring Joe's recorded approval at that locus, with the review materials named as warrant, is the consent-gate pattern verbatim.
